tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. The canvas everything sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, grouped lists, sheets and popovers sitting on bg.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Filled inputs, segmented-control tracks, inset wells.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Elements that sit on top of surface-sunken and must stand out from it: the segmented-control thumb, toggle knobs. In dark it is lighter than the track, as raised things catch light.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and sections. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outlines that identify a control (off toggles, outlined fields). Meets 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: subtitles, row details, captions.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, timestamps. Lowest-emphasis text that still meets 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: primary buttons, links, selected states, focus rings. Use sparingly, at most one primary action per view.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for selected rows and secondary buttons; pair with accent text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive state: confirmations, on-state of a toggle, completed badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution text and icons. State only; never decorative.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors. State only; never decorative.

tokens.name: system-red
tokens.usage: Apple system red. For content colour: tags, category icons, charts, avatars, illustrations; not for interactive controls (that is accent). Contrast on surface — light 3.5:1, dark 5.1:1 → icons and fills in both themes (3:1+).

tokens.name: system-orange
tokens.usage: Apple system orange. For content colour: tags, category icons, charts, avatars, illustrations; not for interactive controls (that is accent). Contrast on surface — light 2.2:1, dark 8.4:1 → in light it fails 3:1 on white, so use it as a fill (with ink text on top), not as icon or text colour; in dark it is fine for icons.

tokens.name: material-ultrathin
tokens.usage: Floating chrome over busy content where the content should show through most: overlays on media, compact HUDs. Always paired with backdrop blur (see the blur tokens and .q-material--ultrathin). Text on it uses ink / ink-secondary only; ink-tertiary and system colours are not guaranteed readable over unknown content.

tokens.name: material-thin
tokens.usage: Toolbars and tab bars over scrolling content. Always paired with backdrop blur (see the blur tokens and .q-material--thin). Text on it uses ink / ink-secondary only; ink-tertiary and system colours are not guaranteed readable over unknown content.

tokens.name: material-regular
tokens.usage: Default material: nav bars, sidebars, popovers, menus. Always paired with backdrop blur (see the blur tokens and .q-material--regular). Text on it uses ink / ink-secondary only; ink-tertiary and system colours are not guaranteed readable over unknown content.

tokens.name: material-thick
tokens.usage: Sheets and panels holding a lot of text; the most legible material. Always paired with backdrop blur (see the blur tokens and .q-material--thick). Text on it uses ink / ink-secondary only; ink-tertiary and system colours are not guaranteed readable over unknown content.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: One per screen, at the top of a page.

styles.name: article-title
styles.usage: Post title at the top of an article (32/38 on phones). Larger than large-title because a post page has nothing else competing.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Top-level section titles; large page headings below the large title.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles, card titles, button labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Quiet keeps the interface out of the way.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Highlighted secondary text: callouts, short descriptions under titles.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: Dense UI, inputs, row subtitles, secondary labels.

styles.name: caption-2
styles.usage: Smallest size allowed: tab-bar labels, dense chart ticks. Never body copy.

styles.name: article-dek
styles.sample: A one-sentence summary that sits under the title.
styles.usage: The standfirst under a post title, in ink-secondary.

styles.name: article-body
styles.sample: Long-form text gets a slightly larger size and looser leading than UI body, so paragraphs breathe.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks; inline code renders at 0.86em of the surrounding text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, control inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default inset: card padding, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups within a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top-of-page breathing room, hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, segmented-control thumbs, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, grouped lists, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, modals, large hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, toggles, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and the segmented-control thumb. In dark, a faint edge replaces the shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, sheets: anything floating above the page.

blur.note: Backdrop blur radii used with the material colours; also boosted saturation (180%) so colour behind the glass stays vivid.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: material-ultrathin; small floating controls.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: material-thin and material-regular: bars, sidebars, menus.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: material-thick: sheets and large panels.

layout.note: Page widths for a blog or personal site.

tokens.name: width-measure
tokens.usage: Reading column for article text: about 65–75 characters at the article size.

tokens.name: width-wide
tokens.usage: Site container: header, footer, post grids, wide figures.

tokens.name: height-header
tokens.usage: Site header bar height.
